**Fix the typecheck:** `LayoutProps` is generated by Next.js 16, so it doesn't exist until `next typegen` or `next build` has run. Add a script and use it instead of the bare `tsc`:

```json
"typecheck": "next typegen && tsc --noEmit"
```

## `types.ts` vs `backend/app/schemas.py`

Add these to stay in sync:

```ts
export interface Statement { id: string; text: string; author_id: string | null; flag?: ModerationReason | null }
export interface Camp { id: string; name: string; description: string; size: number; member_ids: string[] }
```

`Point.text` is already in both. The backend fills it with what the participant said.

## Real API (PR #7), replaces the mocks in `src/lib/api.ts`

Run the backend locally (repo root):

```sh
docker compose up -d          # Postgres
cd backend && uv sync         # Intel Mac works after PR #7
uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload    # http://localhost:8000/docs
```

`frontend/.env.local`:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8000
NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL=ws://localhost:8000/ws
```

| Screen | Call | Request | Response |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 answer | `POST /responses` | **multipart form**: `participant_id`, `text?`, `audio?` (Blob), `neighborhood?`, `age?` (10–120). Send text or audio. | `202 {id, status: "pending"}`, `422` if both are empty, `413` if audio > 10 MB |
| 2 vote | `GET /statements?participant_id=…&limit=20` | — | `Statement[]`: approved statements, not yours, not yet voted |
| 2 vote | `POST /votes` | JSON `{participant_id, statement_id, value: "agree"\|"disagree"\|"pass"}` | `204`. Voting again overwrites. `404` for an unknown statement |
| 3 / board | `GET /clusters` | — | `ClusterResult` (same as `map_updated`) |
| board | `GET /bridges` | — | `Statement[]` |
| 3 "where you are" | (no endpoint) | find `points[].participant_id === getParticipantId()` in `/clusters` | |

```ts
// submitResponse
const form = new FormData();
form.append("participant_id", getParticipantId());
if (input.text) form.append("text", input.text);
if (input.audio) form.append("audio", input.audio, "answer.webm");
if (input.neighborhood) form.append("neighborhood", input.neighborhood);
if (input.age !== null) form.append("age", String(input.age));
const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/responses`, { method: "POST", body: form }); // no Content-Type header: the browser sets the boundary
if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`answer failed: ${res.status}`);
```

**WebSocket `/ws`:** sends `{type, data}` exactly like `ConsultationEvent`. On connect you immediately get `map_updated` and `bridges_updated` with the current state, then live updates after every answer or vote. Your `ws.ts` reconnect logic already fits.

**Timing:** an answer takes a few seconds to become statements (Gemini runs in the background). Don't wait on the POST; show "Mulțumim!" and move to screen 2. If `/statements` is empty, retry after ~3 s.

## Screen 4 + organizer: proposal rounds (real API)

| Who | Call | Request | Response |
|---|---|---|---|
| screen 4 | `GET /proposal` | — | `Proposal` of the current round, or **`null`** before the first round (show "Mediatorul pregătește propunerea") |
| screen 4 | `POST /proposal-votes` | JSON `{participant_id, proposal_id, support: boolean, critique?: string}` (critique ≤ 1000 chars) | `204`. Voting again overwrites. `409` = round closed (a newer one exists), `404` = unknown proposal |
| board / report | `GET /support` | — | `SupportRound[]`, real citizens only (`seed-*` demo participants never counted) |
| organizer | `POST /proposals` | header `X-Organizer-Token: <token>` | `202 {state: "running"}`. `409` if a round is already running, `401` without the token |
| organizer | `GET /proposals/status` | — | `{state: "idle" \| "running" \| "failed", error}`. Poll every ~2 s after starting: mediate takes 25–60 s |

- Map `ProposalVoteInput` to the body: `proposalId` → `proposal_id`, add `participant_id: getParticipantId()`.
- `getProposal()` should return `Proposal | null`.
- `Proposal` now also has an optional `verdict: Verdict | null`: the critic agent's check. Label it as AI if you show it.
- WebSocket: `proposal_published` (when a round is ready) and `support_updated` (after every proposal vote) are sent now.
- Organizer needs a "Generează propunerea" button calling `POST /proposals`. The token is `ORGANIZER_TOKEN` from the server's `.env` (empty locally = no token needed). Ask Rares for it on the deployed server; never commit it.
- `POST /proposals` with no camps on the map → status `failed` with `"mediate needs at least one camp"`. Get a few people to answer and vote first.

## Stable camp ids + organizer answer controls (PR "survive quota outages, stable camp ids")

- **Camp ids are now stable** between map updates and across server restarts: a camp keeps its id (and name, e.g. "Tabăra 1") while people join or leave it. Screen 4 can keep matching `proposal.tradeoffs[].camp_id` to `clusters.camps[].id`, and colors stay put. A genuinely new camp gets a new id and a free name. If a camp splits, the bigger part keeps the id.
- `GET /responses/stats` (organizer token) → `{pending, failed, done}`. Show it on the organizer page, so stuck answers (Gemini quota) are visible.
- `POST /responses/retry` (organizer token) → retries every waiting/failed answer **now** and returns the same counts. Use it after billing is enabled or the daily quota resets. Answers are never given up on: they're retried automatically with growing waits (15 s → 10 min), but this skips the wait.

## Simulated voices on the proposal (proxy agent)

`Proposal.proxies` is a list of `{group, text, simulated: true}`: voices of groups missing from the
consultation (e.g. "Părinți cu copii mici"), written by Bia's proxy agent and taken into account by
the mediator. **Show them with the label "simulat de AI", in a different color, and never in vote
counts or as a camp** (RULES.md section 3). The list is empty if proxy failed or found no missing group.

## Answers to PR #14 questions

- **"After `POST /votes` no `map_updated` within 4 s":** that was a real bug. Slow Gemini intake blocked map updates. Fixed in PR #13: votes now reach the map in about 1 s, even while answers are still processing.
- **Double-tap → duplicate statements:** not handled yet on the backend. Please disable the submit button after the first tap. Server-side dedup is on Rares's list.
